scope: Existing six-scalar SQL compilation and 8192-row paged aggregates. Excludes source I/O, authorization, transport, compound-expression throughput and the subsequently merged PR42 logical/file profile.
method: Pinned ReleaseSafe probes; one warm-up, seven independent samples, alternating candidate/control order; exact identical workload metadata required. Shared host with validation running; no latency acceptance threshold inferred.

initial_owned_plan_vs_foundation.scope: pure compile and paged aggregate; excludes source I/O, authorization and transport

pointer_validation_vs_initial.scope: pure compile and paged aggregate; excludes source I/O, authorization and transport

rejected_lowering_rewrite.scope: pure compile and paged aggregate; excludes source I/O, authorization and transport

retained_change_vs_foundation.scope: pure compile and paged aggregate; excludes source I/O, authorization and transport

decision: Retain pointer-based plan methods and Bound.validate with identical schema/source/fingerprint checks. Revert the separate lowering rewrite: it did not consistently improve compile timings. Remaining compilation overhead is 15–36%; paged aggregate medians are 2.6–2.8% above the foundation in the final comparison. Requalify after PR42 integration; this is not a full-workload performance pass.
